faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about searching and booking a trip

search.question: How do I find a bus trip?
search.answer: Enter the departure city, destination and date in the search form. Live trip search is not connected in the current version.

notFound.question: What should I do if no trips are found?
notFound.answer: Search results and a “no trips found” state are not implemented in the current version, so searching again is not available yet.

chooseTrip.question: How do I choose a trip?
chooseTrip.answer: The results list and “Choose trip” button are not implemented yet, so selecting a trip is not currently possible.

booking.question: How do I complete a booking?
booking.answer: The booking page is currently a placeholder; the booking and confirmation flow has not been implemented.
